# Agentic Architect · Sophia Stein
# https://llmstxt.org

> Essays on AI systems architecture and executive strategy, weekly field notes on Substack, hands-on courses inside the Agentic Architect Lab, and bespoke advisory by Sophia Stein. Based in Boulder, Colorado.

Sophia Stein is an AI Systems Architect, Educator, and Advisor based in Boulder, Colorado. She writes executive architecture essays and open hardware/model benchmarks on Agentic Architect, publishes weekly field notes on Substack, leads hands-on courses inside the Agentic Architect Lab, and advises organizations on governed AI workflows and Fractional CAIO / AI CTO strategy. She has trained 300+ founders and operators live at Boulder Startup Week and spoken for Women Who Code.

## Three Core Surfaces

1. Essays & Research Monograph (https://agenticarchitect.ai/blog, https://agenticarchitect.ai/research): Vendor-neutral systems architecture, department build-vs-buy matrices, tiered model routing, MCP security audits, and The Sovereign Stack 12-chapter monograph.
2. Weekly Substack Dispatch (https://agenticarchitectai.substack.com): Concise weekly synthesis translating frontier AI capabilities, workflow stress tests, and business implications.
3. The Agentic Architect Lab (https://agenticarchitect.ai/courses): Hands-on upskilling tracks covering (01) Claude Superuser & Cowork OS, (02) Kill the $200/mo AI Subscription Stack (Open-Weight & Smart Routing), and (03) Become an AI Architect, with free unlocked cornerstone modules.
